t: This is Black Prince Road, a street in the London Borough of Lambeth. It takes its name from Edward of Woodstock, the Black Prince, eldest son of Edward III. He died before his father, so it was his son who became Richard II. Edward was one of the most successful English commanders of the Hundred Years' War, and English contemporaries saw him as a model of chivalry. French sources, by contrast, remember him for his brutality.
